name: What is the typical timeframe for a cabinet refacing project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeframe for a cabinet refacing project?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard cabinet refacing project typically takes anywhere from 3 to 7 days, depending on the size of your kitchen and the complexity of the work. This timeframe is significantly shorter than a full cabinet replacement, which can take several weeks or even longer. For instance, a smaller kitchen with straightforward design might be completed in a few days, while a larger kitchen with custom features could extend the timeline. One practical tradeoff is that while refacing is faster, you will still experience some disruption in your kitchen during the process.
